places.normalized: Palace of Westminster (House of Commons), London
places.quote: when I went to the Commons as usual, I found Mr. Spenlow in the doorway
places.note: Refers to the House of Commons; the building is the Palace of Westminster.

places.quote: we had a sort of Private Parliament in Buckingham Street
just within the little archway in St. Paul’s Churchyard
places.note: Coffee-house is located just inside an archway here.

places.quote: On my return to Norwood, after the period of absence
places.note: Norwood (south London) is the Spenlows' home.
